_comment: Generic defaults pack 2026-10-07: the two illustrative seed tariffs of the guided study (study_library/tariffs.csv, branch claude/edge-tool-ux-research-n0n2l6), restated as IC Tariffs. Rates are per kWh / per kW-month as the IC model requires; each item's `source_rows` keep the seed row in its own unit (EUR/MWh, EUR/MW/month, EUR/month) and the loader checks rate = price x the closed conversion factor. Export compensation is not an IC tariff item: it is `meta.export.price_per_mwh`, minted into a flat Library series for `export_price_ref` (services/library/export_series.py). `pack_hash` is null here: the loader stamps it on every copy it hands out. Pack 2026-10-26: both tariffs are 2025 EUR, converted 2020 EUR -> 2025 EUR in pack 2026-10-26 (owner decision MONEY-YR-SEED-1): every money figure x 1.2573346011408 = the product of (1 + rate) over 2021 2.9 %, 2022 9.2 %, 2023 6.4 %, 2024 2.6 %, 2025 2.5 % (Eurostat prc_hicp_aind, HICP all items, annual average rate of change, European Economic Area (EEA), 2021-2025, as vendored by technology-data v0.14.0 at inputs/prc_hicp_aind__custom_20097956_spreadsheet.xlsx); not rounded.

meta.jurisdiction_rationale: DE: the seed is modelled on a German industrial bill (Arbeitspreis, Leistungspreis); valid_from 2025-01-01 is the seed's money year (converted from 2020) and valid_to is open, so the out-of-validity preflight does not fire for future modelled years.

honesty.help: Illustrative figures of a plausible order of magnitude, not a published tariff: replace them with the site's own bill.
German network operators bill the capacity charge on the ANNUAL peak (Jahresleistungspreis); this seed bills each month's peak because MVP-1 models one monthly demand charge.

demand.label: Monthly capacity charge on peak import (Leistungspreis)

meta.jurisdiction_rationale: generic: the reference is deliberately jurisdiction-free (it isolates energy time-shift value), so it names no ISO country and joins no tax pack (finance packs bind on the ISO code a tariff carries); valid_from 2025-01-01 is the seed's money year (converted from 2020), valid_to open.
